{{Quote|Well, I tell you what. Kill Face Loran nice and neat, and you can kill one of the Twi'leks, too. Find us a thermal detonator for our experiment and you can kill both.|The Human assassin to the Aqualish assassin|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''assassin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> he, along with [[Unidentified Aqualish assassin|two]] [[Unidentified Sullustan assassin|other]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], [[Attempted assassination on Garik Loran|tried]] to kill [[Wraith Squadron]] leader [[Garik Loran]]. However, as this assassin watched from his [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]], Loran [[Death/Legends|killed]] the other two assassins before returning to his own airspeeder. As Loran's vehicle rose three meters to the air, it exploded due to the explosive package that had been planted aboard while the other two assassins served as a distraction<ref name="MK" />

The Human assassin then went to Loran's [[Garik Loran's apartment|apartment]], where [[Dia Passik]], Loran's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], and their adopted daughter, [[Adra Passik]], were staying. Intending to kill them as well, he broke into the apartment after Loran, who had survived the explosion, secretly warned Dia via [[Comlink/Legends|commlink]]. The assassin confronted Dia while she was packing to leave, but she shot him twice in the abdomen, leaving him mortally wounded and murmuring about not being able to find a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]].<ref name="MK" />
